meaning: 比喻妄想瞞騙他人，結果卻只是欺騙自己而已。貶義。
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website for elementary students in Taiwan. Landscape 3:2. Characters: Taiwanese (East Asian) children and adults drawn in a gentle Japanese anime picture-book style, natural expressions, age-appropriate child proportions (elementary-school kids look 7-12 years old). Setting: present-day Taiwan (Taiwanese schools, streets, homes, parks). Taiwanese school uniform = plain polo shirt or white shirt with shorts/skirt, or sports PE uniform; NO red neckerchief, NO red scarf. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, paper texture visible. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy brown, generous ivory breathing room; no bright flat digital colors, no glossy 3D, no imitation of a named artist. Every person has five fingers per hand, arms clearly attached to shoulders, feet grounded and pointing naturally. scene_prompt: 成語：採『自欺欺人』義。【重點：自己看不見不代表旁人看不見，證據完全露出。】現代台灣家庭餐桌旁，國小男孩偷偷吃完玻璃罐裡的餅乾，嘴角與桌面仍有明顯碎屑。他用雙手遮住雙眼，嘴角露出以為沒人發現的安心笑容；母親站在對面，看著完全透明的空罐與碎屑，神情無奈。母親雙手分開放桌面，男孩兩掌五指自然貼眼周，不增第三手。只畫母子兩人，手臂連肩、腳有支撐，不用古裝、鐘、篆紋、任何文字及類字形符號，器物無品牌。 橫式1536×1024。每人恰兩條獨立手臂，由肩到肘到腕連續，不分岔不共用手掌。每手一拇指四指，外露手部畫大清楚，不加遠景小手。所有人物無紅領巾紅圍巾，無文字字母數字假字類字形商標浮水印。
alt: 男孩吃光餅乾後仍滿嘴碎屑，卻笑著遮住雙眼；母親看著透明空罐與桌上殘屑，無奈地望著以為沒被發現的孩子。
